name: RC-B10-0120/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Türkiye to stop deporting foreign journalists and foreign Christians on national security grounds without evidence or a fair appeal. It asks Türkiye to end the two administrative codes used for these expulsions, to let wrongly expelled people return, and to drop cases against named journalists. It also asks the European Commission to raise these concerns with Türkiye and to consider targeted measures if the abuses continue.

- Türkiye is asked to stop using security codes N-82 and G-87 to expel people.
- Foreign journalists and foreign Christians face deportation; the Parliament backs them.
- The Commission must raise this with Türkiye and weigh targeted measures.
